Name: Huge Shed and an Art Gallery
Author: AkiraTepes
Description:
This is my first mod for this game, so please be gentle.

This mod replaces the interiors of both the basic and upgraded sheds with ones that are double in size due to the fact that the upgraded shed is now an art gallery.


Currently only allows you to use the top-left walls for placement. I have no clue how to fix that, so I'm hoping for someone to let me know.

Downloads.Description: This isn't quite working like I want yet

Manifest.Name: Gallery Mod
Manifest.Description: This mod changes the regular shed to a bigger one and changes the upgraded shed to a shed of the same size, but with a lot of wall space for paintings, posters, windows...etc
